context: Tests: clearing triage pins only, then clearing the whole board while preserving next_id.

checklist.name: Approved pin removed by triage clear
checklist.description: After `/pin clear triage`, item #1 (approved) is absent from `pins.json`.

checklist.name: Pending pin removed by triage clear
checklist.description: After `/pin clear triage`, item #2 (pending) is absent from `pins.json`.

checklist.name: Killed pin kept by triage clear
checklist.description: Item #3 (killed) remains in `pins.json` after `/pin clear triage`.

checklist.name: Scope pin kept by triage clear
checklist.description: Item #4 (scope) remains in `pins.json` after `/pin clear triage`.

checklist.name: Correction pin kept by triage clear
checklist.description: Item #5 (correction) remains in `pins.json` after `/pin clear triage`.

checklist.name: Triage response format
checklist.description: The triage response is a single line of the form `🗑️ Triage cleared. 3 pins remaining.`

checklist.name: Full clear empties items
checklist.description: After `/pin clear`, the `items` array in `pins.json` is empty.

checklist.name: next_id preserved on clear
checklist.description: After `/pin clear`, `next_id` is still 6 and is not reset to 1.

checklist.name: Clear response format
checklist.description: The full clear response is exactly `🗑️ Pin board cleared.` with no extra commentary.

checklist.name: No ids renumbered or reused
checklist.description: Surviving items keep their original `id` values and no id is reassigned during either command.
